name: veyra-browser
description: Veyra Browser Android wrapper and static web application.

scripts.check: node scripts/verify-source.cjs && node scripts/verify-console-lab.cjs && node scripts/verify-extensions.cjs && node tests/source-address.test.js && node tests/fast-proxy-fallback.test.js && node tests/youtube-fallback.test.js && node tests/extension-patterns.test.js && node tests/diagnostics-export.test.js && node tests/api-authorization.test.js && node tests/proxy-compatibility.test.js && node tests/qa-outcomes.test.js
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
